Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestBritishCutoverChronology_test_atTime_null.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestBritishCutoverChronology/TestBritishCutoverChronology_test_atTime_null.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The original test has one tiny test method buried under ~120 lines of unused data-provider methods. The understandability win is to remove all that dead code and keep only what the single test needs.Single overload — `atTime(null)` is unambiguous. Now compiling.Compiles cleanly. I reduced the test from ~195 lines to 19 by removing the ~120 lines of unused data-provider methods and 50+ unused imports, keeping only the single `test_atTime_null` behaviour (now with a named local and an explanatory comment). Runtime behaviour is unchanged: the same `BritishCutoverDate.of(2014, 5, 26).atTime(null)` call asserting a `NullPointerException`.
